report.title: Defending Nuclear Infrastructure: When Might Lethal Force Be Necessary to Prevent Catastrophe?
report.summary: Lawful recourse to lethal force in the defense of a civilian nuclear power plant rests on a sharp legal and moral separation between protecting ordinary industrial property and preventing an imminent, catastrophic threat to human life1.
